paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.06% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.46%) and Dow Jones weakest (-0.35%). Brent crude changed +0.62% to 106.35. Gold changed -0.23% to 4,167.5. Bitcoin changed +0.35% to 83,389.6094. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.217%, a relative move of -0.44%. Among the firms tracked, Citigroup (-5.60%) and KKR (-4.75%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: BlackRock pulls in $205bn to take assets to record high (FT World). World’s largest asset manager has become an increasingly powerful force in private capital after acquisitions of HPS and Global Infrastructure Partners Deals and capital markets: General Atlantic plans early 2027 IPO at up to $10bn valuation (FT World). Private capital group looks to fund ambitious expansion plan to keep pace with rivals Blackstone and Apollo Global Central banks and macro: US grocery prices poised to climb as soaring fuel costs drive inflation (FT Companies). Food manufacturers warn of impact on consumers ahead of midterm elections Central banks and macro: ‘I think a lot of people are waking up’: Trump’s Latino vote starts to unravel (FT World). Inflation, war and the crackdown on immigrant communities draw the crucial swing voters back to the Democrats ahead of the midterms Geopolitics and trade: Gulf oil production rebounds ahead of increase in Iran war hostilities (FT Markets). Saudi Arabia says output in September hit highest level since start of conflict, though revival now at risk from renewed attacks on shipping this month
